claim_boundary: NOT A ROS 2 REAL-TIME CERTIFIED CONTROLLER
NOT A UNIVERSAL ROBOTS PRODUCTION DRIVER
NOT A POWER PMAC ROS DRIVER
message_choice: sensor_msgs/JointState carries named joint positions in radians. /joint_states publishes actual_q only. /robotwin/target_joint_states publishes target_q only. command_id, controller_state, fault, and execution_state are not JointState fields. Those values use a JSON object in std_msgs/String so the ROS message is not the canonical command model. header.frame_id is not used as command_id.

qos.reason: Default reliable profile so localhost delivery can be counted. sensor_data best effort can drop samples. This is not a safety guarantee.

shutdown_policy: Adapter shutdown calls disconnect() on the controller. An active MOVE_JOINT is aborted with execution REJECTED and error_code DISCONNECTED. controller_state becomes DISCONNECTED. actual joint positions are left where they are. This is session teardown, not an E-stop and not a safety-certified stop.
